classValueDefinitions

MySqlpackages/sql-faker/src/MySql/Generation/Lexeme/ValueDefinitions.php:23
final class ValueDefinitions

Lexical domains from sql/sql_lex.cc: identifiers, get_text, int_token and numeric scanner states. Representative values are defaults, not the accepted domain for an explicit Plan. Constructed names also satisfy sql/table.cc:check_table_name length and final-space checks.

Methods§

public function create(): LexemeGenerator
100%source§

Combines the value-producing scanner states, with quoting kept inside each lexeme.
